title: Support Programme for Students from Countries Affected by Armed Conflicts – SCAAC / Free University of Bozen-Bolzano
blocks: Selected students will be exempt from tuition fees, except for the €16 revenue stamp. While studying at unibz, they will receive financial support of €1,200 per month (including taxes) to cover housing and living expenses. The selected candidate(s) will be entitled to the following additional support throughout the entire duration of the project:

The programme is open to applicants who come from countries affected by armed conflict and who meet the entry requirements described below. Eligible applicants may already be in Italy or may reside abroad, including in their country of origin.
be enrolled in a bachelor's or master's degree programme at a foreign university; or

Only the first six applicants who submit their application and select the programme “ Support Programme for Students from Countries Affected by Armed Conflicts (SCAAC) ” will be admitted, if they meet the requirements and submit the required documents by the deadline. Selected applicants will be informed by email.
Upload the required documents listed below.
Submit the online application by the deadline.
Only documents submitted by the deadline will be assessed. Applicants who cannot document the required entry qualification by the deadline will be excluded from the procedure.

Up to six students enrolled in single subject courses will receive a study grant of €1,200 per month (tax included) to cover housing and living expenses, with funding available until 24 September 2027 . Selected students are exempt from tuition fees, except for the one-off €16 revenue stamp , and can eat in the University canteen free of charge.
